mcp_tools.name: content_create_blog
mcp_tools.description: Create a draft AI blog item (status=draft). Provide a title and content_type; optionally a slug, a brief, and seed draft markdown. Returns { item }. Run content_generate_blog next to AI-generate the draft, then content_publish_blog to publish.

mcp_tools.name: content_generate_blog
mcp_tools.description: Queue the AI generation workflow for a blog item. This is ASYNC: the item moves draft -> researching -> ... -> draft_ready. The response only confirms the job queued; poll content_get_blog (or GET /content/blog/{id}) for the status. Returns { item, workflow_run_id, status }.

mcp_tools.name: content_generate_post
mcp_tools.description: Generate a draft social post for LinkedIn or X from a topic, optionally with a tone and a post format. Persists a draft (status=draft) and returns it; it does NOT send. Generation is hard-capped at 24s; an overrun returns a generation_timeout error and saves nothing. Publish or schedule the draft afterwards.

mcp_tools.name: content_get_blog
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a single AI blog item by id. Returns { item } or a not_found error. Poll this after content_generate_blog to watch status move to draft_ready.

mcp_tools.name: content_get_post
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a single post by id. Returns { post } or a not_found error.

mcp_tools.name: content_list_accounts
mcp_tools.description: List the connected LinkedIn and X accounts in the workspace, each with a health flag so you can pick an account_id to schedule or publish from. Returns { accounts }.

mcp_tools.name: content_list_blog
mcp_tools.description: List AI blog items in the workspace, newest first. Page with cursor (pass the prior next_cursor); filter by status (e.g. draft, draft_ready, published). Returns { items, next_cursor }; next_cursor is null on the last page.

mcp_tools.name: content_list_posts
mcp_tools.description: List posts in the workspace, newest first. Page with cursor (pass the prior next_cursor); filter by platform and/or status. Returns { posts, next_cursor }; next_cursor is null on the last page.

mcp_tools.name: content_post_analytics
mcp_tools.description: Read social-rollup metrics (e.g. impressions) for a published post by its id. LinkedIn metrics come from the publish rollup; X metrics from the tracked-tweet rollup. Returns analytics: { post_id, platform, status, impressions }.

mcp_tools.name: content_publish_blog
mcp_tools.description: Publish a blog item. With self_hosted true (or no destination_id) it publishes to the public /blog/<slug>; otherwise it publishes to the named workspace destination_id. Returns { item, status }.

mcp_tools.name: content_publish_post
mcp_tools.description: Publish a draft/queued post NOW through a specific connected account. Enforces a per-account daily publish cap AND a per-cycle cap, the account health + approval gates, and an atomic row-claim before dispatch. Requires an explicit, workspace-scoped account_id (LinkedIn or X). Returns status: accepted (published) | queued (per-cycle full, scheduler will drain) | blocked (unhealthy / approval pending / daily cap reached). Optional idempotency_key makes retries safe.

mcp_tools.name: content_schedule_post
mcp_tools.description: Schedule a draft post for a future time through a specific connected account. Deferred publishing is an action: it reserves a future-day per-account publish slot at schedule time (same daily cap as publish-now). Requires an explicit, workspace-scoped account_id and an ISO scheduled_date. Returns status: accepted (queued for the scheduler) | blocked (unhealthy / daily cap reached).

mcp_tools.name: crm_field_mappings
mcp_tools.description: List the workspace field mappings for the selected CRM provider. Returns the configured local contact field to CRM property mappings.

mcp_tools.name: crm_sync
mcp_tools.description: Enqueue an outbound contact upsert to the selected CRM provider. The durable CRM worker owns retries, deduplication, and dead-letter handling. Returns the queued job result.

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_get_capability
mcp_tools.description: Read one canonical capability by stable id, such as intent:outreach.find_email, column:ai, source:linkedin_search, event:run.completed, or resource:runs. This is read-only, has no cost, and tells an agent exactly when to use it, when not to use it, required inputs, side effects, required scopes, async/cost policy, and the REST or MCP call to make next. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_get)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_get_function
mcp_tools.description: Read one registered GTM function definition before running it. This is read-only and has no cost. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_get)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_get_run
mcp_tools.description: Poll or inspect a /v1/run execution by run_id. Read-only, no cost. Returns the run row and ordered steps, including status, output envelope, errors, provider/source metadata, and timestamps. Use after dreamstate_run returns 202/accepted or when debugging a workflow.

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_list_resources
mcp_tools.description: Read resource indexes that help an agent orient itself before acting. For capabilities, providers, intents, and events it returns registry metadata; for runs it returns recent /v1/run executions. This is read-only and has no cost.

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_run
mcp_tools.description: Execute any /api/v1/run intent through the same core used by REST. Use dreamstate_get_capability first to inspect required inputs, required scopes, cost, side effects, idempotency, and async behavior. Mutating intents may change lists, campaigns, tables, content, or sends; paid intents may reserve credits; slow intents return { accepted, run_id/job_id } and should be polled with dreamstate_get_run. The underlying intent enforces its own scope, so a read-only key cannot run write/action intents. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_run)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_run_function
mcp_tools.description: Run a registered multi-step GTM function through the same governed /api/v1/run executor. Supports dry-run planning and a maximum credit cap. Mutating functions require an idempotency key in live mode. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_run)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_search_capabilities
mcp_tools.description: Discover what Dreamstate can do before choosing a tool or /v1/run intent. Use this first when an agent needs to build lists, add source/enrichment columns, enrich contacts, publish content, inspect SEO/GEO data, manage webhooks, or find the right next action. This is read-only, has no cost, and returns capability records with required scopes, side effects, async policy, cost policy, REST paths, MCP tool names, inputs, outputs, and examples. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_search)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_search_functions
mcp_tools.description: Search registered multi-step GTM functions by id, name, description, or intended use. This is read-only and has no cost. (deprecated: use dreamstate_tools_search)

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_tools_get
mcp_tools.description: Read one intent or GTM function from the unified Dreamstate tool registry. This is read-only and has no cost.

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_tools_run
mcp_tools.description: Run one intent or GTM function through the existing governed execution core.

mcp_tools.name: dreamstate_tools_search
mcp_tools.description: Search the unified Dreamstate tool registry for intents and GTM functions. This is read-only and has no cost.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_activate_campaign
mcp_tools.description: Activate a campaign so the capped engine begins outreach. This is the only outward action here: it routes through the SAME activation gate the in-app flow uses (it rejects an unconfigured campaign or one missing a signal / imported contacts). A reject returns status:blocked with the gate reason and does NOT start sending; a pass returns status:accepted. Requires the actions scope.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_add_column
mcp_tools.description: Add a column to a campaign data table. Use column_type for the full typed engine: ai, formula, email_find, phone_find, enrichment, waterfall, crm_lookup, merge_columns, assigned_to, or a basic value type. Legacy kind=freeform/enrichment/step-output still works. Mutates the table and returns { column }. Run runnable columns next with dreamstate_run using intent outreach.table.run_column.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_add_step
mcp_tools.description: Add a step (node) to a campaign sequence under the graph_version compare-and-set. Optionally pass after_step_id to wire an edge from that step to the new one. The graph is re-validated; a concurrent edit returns graph_version_conflict (re-read with outreach_get_sequence and retry). Returns { graph, graph_version }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_add_to_list
mcp_tools.description: Create or update contacts and add them to an outreach list using the same contact upsert core.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_analytics
mcp_tools.description: Read workspace-level outreach analytics over a rolling window. metric=overview returns reply rate, acceptance rate, sends, leads, demos booked, an adaptive-grain trend, and a per-campaign breakdown. metric=icp returns the ICP breakdown, sender the per-sender breakdown, signal_source the per-signal-source breakdown.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_apply_template
mcp_tools.description: Apply a versioned template to an editable pristine outreach table. This creates explicit sources and columns transactionally and never starts an import or activates the campaign.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_archive_contact
mcp_tools.description: Soft-archive a contact: remove active list memberships, stop active sequence instances, preserve history.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_assign_thread
mcp_tools.description: Assign a LinkedIn conversation to a workspace member, or pass user_id:null to clear the assignment. A non-null user_id must be a member of this workspace. Returns { conversation_urn, assigned_to_user_id }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_bulk_upsert_contacts
mcp_tools.description: Enqueue an async bulk contact import job. Poll the returned job id over the v1 REST API.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_campaigns
mcp_tools.description: List outreach campaigns in the workspace, newest first. Page with cursor (pass the prior cursor_value); filter by status. Returns { items, cursor_value }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_create_campaign
mcp_tools.description: Create a draft outreach campaign bound to an existing list. Configure targeting and the sequence next, then activate.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_create_list
mcp_tools.description: Create an outreach list in the workspace. Idempotent on a case-insensitive name match (returns the existing list); pass fresh:true to always mint a new list, suffixing the name when it collides. Returns the list.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_delete_column
mcp_tools.description: Archive a campaign table column (soft delete, matching the in-app UI; it is not hard-deleted and can be restored). Returns { archived: true }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_draft_message
mcp_tools.description: Draft a LinkedIn opener for a contact using a named opener framework. Returns the suggested text only; it does NOT send. Supply campaign_id to use that campaign's messaging config.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_edit_column
mcp_tools.description: Edit an existing campaign table column: rename it (label), set its description / color, toggle hidden / pinned, or reposition it. Internal column-engine fields are not editable here; archive a column with outreach_delete_column. Returns { column }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_edit_step
mcp_tools.description: Replace the data payload (kind, subtype, config) of one step in a campaign sequence under the graph_version compare-and-set. A concurrent edit returns graph_version_conflict. Returns { graph, graph_version }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_enrich_contact
mcp_tools.description: Enrich a contact with company firmographics (industry, company size). Costs 1 credit on a served provider call and is bounded by the key daily spend cap. Off-account; no LinkedIn account needed.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_enroll
mcp_tools.description: Enroll a contact into an outreach campaign. The campaign engine drains the enrollment under its own per-account daily caps and reserves any connection slot at dispatch; this never sends directly. Returns status: accepted (queued for the engine) | queued (already enrolled) | blocked (campaign not enrollable). Idempotent on client_request_id.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_find_leads
mcp_tools.description: Source LinkedIn leads via people search through a specific connected account. Bounded-sync: returns results when fast, or a job id (status:working) for the slow path. Requires account_id; bounded by the key daily spend cap.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_get_campaign_table
mcp_tools.description: Read a campaign's data table: its columns plus a cursor-paginated page of contact rows, each with the cell values for those columns. Page with cursor (pass the prior next_cursor). Returns { columns, rows, next_cursor }; next_cursor is null on the last page.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_get_contact
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a single outreach contact by id. Returns { contact } or a not_found error.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_get_sequence
mcp_tools.description: Read a campaign's outreach sequence: the graph of steps (nodes) and their wiring (edges), plus graph_version (the version you must pass-through when editing to avoid clobbering a concurrent change). Returns { graph, graph_version }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_get_step_options
mcp_tools.description: List the building blocks the sequence builder offers: action subtypes (send_dm, send_connection_request, wait, ...), trigger subtypes, opener frameworks, and (when campaign_id is given) that campaign's variable tokens. Returns { action_subtypes, trigger_subtypes, opener_frameworks, variable_tokens }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_list_contacts
mcp_tools.description: List outreach contacts in the workspace, newest first. Page with cursor (pass the prior cursor_value); filter by a name substring with search. Returns { items, cursor_value }; cursor_value is null on the last page.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_list_signal_types
mcp_tools.description: List the signal trigger types an intent_signals campaign can target (engaged with a post, viewed your profile, changed jobs, ...), each with its label, description, category, and whether it requires Sales Navigator. Returns { signal_types }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_lists
mcp_tools.description: List the outreach lists (audiences) in the workspace. Returns { items }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_mark_thread_read
mcp_tools.description: Mark every unread message in a LinkedIn conversation as read. The conversation_urn is the thread id from outreach_list_threads. Returns { ok, marked } (the count flipped).

mcp_tools.name: outreach_pause_campaign
mcp_tools.description: Pause a campaign. Mirrors the in-app kill-switch cascade so in-flight instances actually stop, not just the row flip. Pause is a write (not an outward action), so it needs outreach:write rather than the actions scope. Returns { campaign }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_remove_step
mcp_tools.description: Remove a step (node) and its incident edges from a campaign sequence under the graph_version compare-and-set. If the removal would orphan downstream steps the graph is rejected (rewire first). A concurrent edit returns graph_version_conflict. Returns { graph, graph_version }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_send_connection
mcp_tools.description: Queue a LinkedIn connection request to a contact by enrolling them into a connection campaign. Enroll-only: the campaign engine reserves the connection slot and fires the invite under its own ramp cap at dispatch; this never sends directly. Requires account_id (bound to the campaign sender) and a client_request_id. Returns status: accepted | queued | blocked.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_send_reply
mcp_tools.description: Send a manual LinkedIn reply into an existing conversation through a specific account. Enforces the per-account daily DM cap BEFORE sending: at cap it returns status:blocked with no send. Requires account_id (must own the thread) and a client_request_id for idempotent retries.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_set_cell
mcp_tools.description: Write one cell value for a contact in a campaign table, addressed by column key (the key from outreach_get_campaign_table). Only editable columns accept a write. Returns { ok: true }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_set_thread_status
mcp_tools.description: Set the human pipeline status on a LinkedIn conversation, or pass status:null to clear it. Returns { conversation_urn, status }.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_update_contact
mcp_tools.description: Patch writable contact fields. Omitted fields are untouched; explicit null clears nullable fields.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_upsert_contact
mcp_tools.description: Create or update an outreach contact using tiered identity: external_id and linkedin_url are strong keys, email is opt-in via match_on.

mcp_tools.name: outreach_validate_sequence
mcp_tools.description: Run the structural validator on a campaign's current sequence (the same checks activation runs: cycles, orphan steps, unwired branches). Returns { valid, error } where error is the first structural problem or null.

mcp_tools.name: ping
mcp_tools.description: Health probe. Returns "pong" and the workspace the API key resolves to. Use this to confirm the MCP connection works.

mcp_tools.name: playbooks_list
mcp_tools.description: List available Dreamstate skills, approved API playbooks, and active workspace reply-card playbooks. Returns their ids, titles, status, and required scopes.

mcp_tools.name: playbooks_run
mcp_tools.description: Run a playbook by id or slug using manifest-defined steps or explicit intent and steps. Returns the same synchronous or accepted asynchronous run envelope as the REST API.

mcp_tools.name: seo_competitor_ranks
mcp_tools.description: Read competitor organic rank observations from persisted DataForSEO-backed SEO tracking. This is read-only and has no cost. Returns domains grouped with keyword positions and best_rank. Use after seo_keyword_tracking has collected observations.

mcp_tools.name: seo_keyword_tracking
mcp_tools.description: Collect Google organic ranks for owned and competitor domains using DataForSEO-backed SERP snapshots, then persist observations. This may spend DataForSEO budget and changes rank-tracking state. Requires owned_domain, keywords, and visibility:write. Returns observations with best_owned_rank, competitor_positions, SERP timestamp, cache/source metadata, and errors if provider budget/circuit gates block collection.

mcp_tools.name: seo_rank_overview
mcp_tools.description: Read persisted Google organic rank observations collected through DataForSEO-backed SERP snapshots. This is read-only and has no cost. Returns recent observations, best owned rank, and source metadata. Use seo_keyword_tracking first if no observations exist.

mcp_tools.name: visibility_ai_traffic
mcp_tools.description: Read GA4 referral traffic from AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) for the workspace: total AI sessions, delta vs the prior period, trend, top landing pages, and a breakdown by referrer. If GA4 is not connected or no property is selected, returns a ga4_not_connected / ga4_property_not_selected error body; if the GA4 quota is exhausted, ga4_quota_exhausted. Returns the AI-traffic object.

mcp_tools.name: visibility_citations
mcp_tools.description: Read the AI-citation detail for the workspace: top cited domains (with average position), the geo citation-event rollup (composite score + engine breakdown), top owned pages, competitor citation diffs, keyword volumes, and source gaps (domains where competitors are cited but the brand is not). Returns the aggregated citations object.

mcp_tools.name: visibility_overview
mcp_tools.description: Read the headline AI-visibility numbers for the workspace: visibility score, citation coverage, rank, share of voice, per-engine citation rate, brand sentiment, and the brand name/domain. Derived from probe runs across AI search engines. Returns the overview object.

mcp_tools.name: visibility_refresh
mcp_tools.description: Trigger a fresh AI-visibility citation/probe pass for the workspace. Fire-and-forget: the pass runs on the AI service in the background and this returns immediately with { accepted, workspace_id, queued_query_count }. Optionally pass query_ids to refresh only specific tracked queries; omit to refresh all.

mcp_tools.name: webhooks_create
mcp_tools.description: Create a signed outbound webhook subscription for this workspace. Mutates webhook configuration, has no credit cost, requires an HTTPS URL, and returns the signing secret exactly once. Use this when an external agent/app needs run.completed, reply.received, usage.ceiling_reached, seo.rank.changed, or other Dreamstate events. Call webhooks_test_delivery next to verify the endpoint.

mcp_tools.name: webhooks_delete
mcp_tools.description: Delete a workspace webhook subscription. This mutates webhook configuration, has no credit cost, and stops future deliveries for that webhook id. Use only when the receiving endpoint should no longer receive Dreamstate events.

mcp_tools.name: webhooks_list
mcp_tools.description: Read existing workspace webhook subscriptions. This is read-only, has no cost, and returns webhook ids, subscribed events, active state, delivery counters, and URLs without exposing signing secrets. Call webhooks_create next when no suitable subscription exists.

mcp_tools.name: webhooks_test_delivery
mcp_tools.description: Enqueue a sample signed webhook delivery through the same durable outbox as real events. Mutates delivery state, has no credit cost, and returns whether the test was queued. Use after webhooks_create to verify endpoint signing, retries, and receiver handling.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_apply
mcp_tools.description: Create a workflow when workflow_id is omitted, or replace an existing workflow graph when workflow_id is provided.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_get
mcp_tools.description: Get one workspace-owned GTM workflow and its graph.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_list
mcp_tools.description: List workspace-owned GTM workflows.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_metrics
mcp_tools.description: Get workflow run and analytics metrics for a selected period.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_run
mcp_tools.description: Enroll one contact or an audience of contacts into a workspace-owned workflow.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_runs
mcp_tools.description: List recent runs for a workspace-owned workflow.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_trace
mcp_tools.description: Get the execution trace for one workflow subject.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_trigger_create
mcp_tools.description: Create a webhook, analytics, or LinkedIn engagement trigger for a workspace-owned workflow.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_trigger_delete
mcp_tools.description: Delete one trigger from a workspace-owned workflow.

mcp_tools.name: workflow_triggers
mcp_tools.description: List webhook, analytics, and LinkedIn engagement triggers for a workspace-owned workflow.
